summary: A young man holds a camera in selfie mode as he enters a climbing gym building and walks up an interior staircase with his backpack and jacket.

people.description: Young East Asian man with fluffy dark hair, wearing a brown short-sleeved button-up shirt over a grey tank top, backpack, silver chain, and AirPods, holding a black jacket.

quality.issues: Occasional lens flare and sunlight blowout in the first few seconds near entrance doors.

moments.action: Creator walks through the glass doorway into the spacious building lobby holding the camera selfie-style.
Creator walks up the indoor staircase, sun filtering in from behind as he looks ahead.
